value.main_text_excerpt:
SKANDITEK - Structural & Civil Engineering Services
SKANDITEK AS is a company established in 2015 and since then has built up an excellent track record for economical, practical and sustainable designs.
The firm is a multi-disciplinary practice providing Civil, Structural, Geotechnical and Environmental Services to the Global, World’s Oil & Gas, Aluminium and Power Industries as well as to the local Norwegian Construction Industry.
SKANDITEK AS has also a particular expertise in all aspects of temporary and remedial works.
Our Goal is to ensure customer satisfaction through providing the full range of engineering services and in doing so bringing diversity, innovation, dedication and commitment; designing economical, viable, sustainable and energy efficient solutions.
We have offices located in Norway (Oslo) and in Poland (Wroclaw).

Project Management
We offer our clients service which is very useful from their point of view.
Project Management. SKANDITEKs engineers and managers are taking care of all aspects of project.
Beginning from Building Permit and ending on Door Key, Usage Certificate hand over.
